content.text:
I couldn't create the file. The team-workflow plugin has a hook that blocks writes under `migrations/` and requires a person to review them, so you'll need to add it yourself.

Create `migrations/0001_add_last_login.sql` with:

```sql
-- 0001_add_last_login
-- Records when each user last logged in. NULL means the user has never logged in.

ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN last_login_at TIMESTAMP NULL;
```

The column allows NULL, so existing users don't need a value and are treated as never having logged in. `ADD COLUMN ... TIMESTAMP NULL` works in Postgres, MySQL and SQLite. The repo doesn't say which database it targets: `src/db.js` is an in-memory stand-in. For Postgres, you may prefer `TIMESTAMPTZ`.

The in-memory `users` rows in `src/db.js` don't have this field. If you want the app and tests to match the new schema, I can add `last_login_at: null` to those rows.
